scientific_queries.note: Attempt to make the R112 conditional rule actionable by an online probe-and-decide agent.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round is invalidated by a degeneracy signature, and it records a new standing check rather than a scientific result.

design_bug.symptom: the probe-estimated prior accuracy is 1.33 to 1.67 percent against a true 9 to 11 percent, and the decision to personalise fires in 94 to 97 percent of cases
design_bug.cause: PROBE was set to 20, exactly equal to K, so taking the top-K of a 20-key probe selects every probe key and the estimate becomes the pool base rate of about 1.4 percent
design_bug.consequence: the adaptive arm collapses onto the always-personalise arm, so the agent question is not answered
design_bug.fix: the probe must be materially larger than K, for example 100 keys for K=20

what_is_still_informative.reading: if the agent knew which action was better per cell it would gain 2.71 pp, so the decision itself has value; this round simply failed to inform it

recurring_pattern.R104: identity and identity+gene identical - three changes made at once
recurring_pattern.R108: personalisation arm identical to prior - a constant cannot reorder
recurring_pattern.R113: decision rate 94 to 97 percent - probe equals K so the estimate is the base rate
recurring_pattern.common_fault: not asking in advance whether the quantity can carry the intended information: whether the change can alter the result, or whether the estimate can reflect what it is meant to estimate
recurring_pattern.new_standing_check: any estimator must be shown to be non-degenerate by design before it is allowed to drive a decision

limits: probe size 20 and threshold 9.5 percent were both unvalidated choices
the two prior levels bracket the threshold rather than sampling it
retrospective; no mechanism, clinical or drug-choice claim; no meta-learning or RSI
next_gates: rerun with a 100-key probe and K=20, first checking that the estimate lands near 9-11 percent, then whether the adaptive arm beats both fixed strategies

register_updates.C86: new: the run is invalid and the estimator was degenerate by construction
